title: Metabolites, Lipids, Protein Extraction Protocol (MPLEx)
author: Heather Olson
materials: Once the lipid sample (or process blank) has been placed into the Waters autosampler vial, apply a breathable tube membrane to the top of the vial and dry sample completely in a centrifugal concentrator (e.g. Labconco Centrivap, Thermo SpeedVac).

steps.title: Sample Preparation and Tube Selection
steps.instruction: Prepare samples and select appropriate microcentrifuge tubes based on mass.

substeps.instruction: For biofluids or tissues, ensure volume is 200 µL or less (use 4 ℃ MilliQ water to cover tissues).
For higher volume samples with low protein concentration (e.g., BALF), lyophilize to dryness and reconstitute with water.
For samples < 200 µL, bring volume up to 200 µL with water in a 1.5-mL microcentrifuge tube (do not use buffer).
Select tube size: 1.5-mL tube for small biopsies (100-200 mg) or 5-mL tube for larger samples.
Obtain the weight of each tissue before processing for normalization.

steps.title: Initial Homogenization (Tissue/Cell Pellets)
steps.instruction: Homogenize tissue or cell pellets using a solvent mixture.

substeps.instruction: For samples in a 1.5-mL tube, add 470 µL of ice-cold (-20 ℃) 4:3 Methanol:Water.
Homogenize the pellet using a pellet pestle homogenizer.
Vortex samples for 1 minute.
Centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 10 minutes at 4 ℃.

steps.title: Phase Separation Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform solvent extraction to separate metabolites, lipids, and proteins using the 8:4:3 Chloroform:Methanol:Water ratio.

substeps.instruction: Add 530 µL of ice-cold (-20 ℃) chloroform to homogenized samples.
Vortex at highest speed for 1 minute.
Place samples on ice for 5 minutes.

Alternatively, for liquid samples: add 800 µL of cold (-20 ℃) 2:1 Chloroform:Methanol to 200 µL of sample, vortex briefly, place on ice, vortex at highest speed for 1 minute, rest on ice for 5 minutes, vortex again for 1 minute, and centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 10 minutes at 4 ℃.

steps.title: Phase Recovery
steps.instruction: Isolate the three distinct layers using Pasteur pipettes.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the top (polar, metabolite) layer into a new tube or vial.
Gently push past the protein interphase to transfer the lower (non-polar, lipid) layer into a Waters Corp Clear Glass 12 x 32 mm Screw Neck Total Recovery Vial.
Wash the protein interlayer with 1 mL of cold (-20 ℃) Methanol and centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 10 minutes at 4 ℃.

steps.title: Protein Pellet Processing
steps.instruction: Dry and store the protein pellet for subsequent proteomics.

substeps.instruction: Gently pour off the methanol and place tubes upside down in a fume hood for 5 minutes to dry (do not exceed 5 minutes).
Store pellets at -80 ℃ if not processed immediately.
Re-solubilize in 50 mM NH4HCO3, pH ~8 buffer for protein digestion.

steps.title: Metabolite Layer Purification
steps.instruction: Dry, resuspend, and filter the metabolite layer.

substeps.instruction: Apply a breathable tube membrane and dry the sample completely in a centrifugal concentrator (e.g., Labconco Centrivap, Thermo SpeedVac).
Add 150-200 µL of 80:20 methanol:water to the dried sample.
Vortex and sonicate until dissolved (maximum 5 minutes).
Centrifuge samples at 21,000 x g for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Metabolite Filtration
steps.instruction: Filter the metabolite supernatant using a positive pressure system.

substeps.instruction: Pre-condition a 1-mL, 0.2µm PTFE 96 filter well plate with 2x 0.5 mL methanol, then 2x 0.5 mL ultrapure water using a N2 positive pressure system.
Discard waste and tap the plate upside down on a Kimwipe to ensure no water remains.
Place the filter plate on a new 1-mL 96-well collection plate.
Transfer the supernatant from the centrifuged samples (and process blanks) into the filter plate.
Push samples through the filter using the positive pressure system (do not exceed 9 psi).
Transfer filtered samples into Waters Corp Clear Glass 12 x 32 mm Screw Neck Total Recovery Vials.
Seal with non-slit autosampler vial caps (Red PTFE / White Silicone Rubber / Red PTFE Septa) and store at -20 ℃.

steps.title: Lipid Layer Processing
steps.instruction: Dry and reconstitute the lipid layer.

substeps.instruction: Dry the sample (using a breathable membrane).
Remove membrane and add 500 µL of chloroform to the vial.
Seal with a non-slit autosampler vial cap (Red PTFE / White Silicone Rubber / Red PTFE Septa) and vortex briefly to dissolve residue.
Perform this step within 30-45 minutes to avoid lipid oxidation.
Store samples at -20 ℃.
